title: Dynamic Object-Relational Metadata Mapping
pattern: Reading columns, fields, and types dynamically from runtime configuration arrays, translating database values into generic key-value maps.
why_bad: It is slow, thrashes performance via heavy reflective parsing, and bypasses static compiler guarantees. It forces developers to debug simple spelling errors at runtime.
detection: The presence of metadata parsing logic and arrays of `ColumnMap` structs parsed dynamically.
counterexample: `Context-dependent`. Generic, low-level object-relational mapping (ORM) libraries or database clients where mapping must work across arbitrary user tables.
source: [The Addison-Wesley signature series] Martin Fowler - _Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture_ (2015_2002, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Chapter 10 "Metadata Mapping".
